projectState.summary: Byte 11c-a is approved by Claude and merged to main. Melody slow-thinking now allows `shift_register`; accepted register intents derive a bounded one-octave shift from source/target octave, expose it through `window.thinking.getSlowPlayback().registerShift`, and apply it as a pitch override to existing scheduled melody notes only. Shifted events are tagged `thought:shift_register` plus `register:+/-N`. Pulse/bass are untouched, no note slots are added or reordered, and future material injection still belongs in the commit/lookahead path. Claude accepted the bounded rescue behavior but asked that it be named as slow-thought precedence over taste rests; next protocol cleanup should add explicit `registerDelta`, and replay/event-log work should record grid pitch versus performed pitch structurally. Validation: Claude reran build/audit/diff/smoke 15/15.
